sponsor_or_proposer: Gabon Oil Company (GOC); JV partner(s) not finalised (GOC "looking for investors")
current_state: Early-stage micro-LNG concept on the Mboga II licence (Mboumba field, which flares ~70,000 m3/day). GOC plan: small liquefaction at the flare site, LNG put in containers and trucked/barged across the country to power-plant sites with regasification (a "virtual pipeline" to displace gasoil-fired power). Per the canonical (2021) report, FEED was being concluded (~Apr 20) with FID targeted for the following month and an estimated cost of US$23-30m. No evidence of FID, a finalised JV/partner, or any construction step in any 2022-2026 source reviewed; Gabon's 2023 Gas Master Plan coverage and all 2024-2026 LNG reporting focus on the Cap Lopez FLNG terminal and gas-to-power plants (Owendo), not Mboga.
missing_threshold_elements: Sponsor only partly identified (GOC named but the operating JV/partner is explicitly not finalised); no confirmed concrete step has advanced since the 2021 FEED-conclusion target (no announced FID, EPC award, permit, or site works); facility type is borderline for the tracker (containerised micro-LNG feeding a road/barge virtual pipeline rather than a fixed marine LNG terminal).
watch_for: A finalised JV/partner or named operator for Mboga II; an announced FID, EPC/equipment award, or construction start for a micro-LNG liquefaction unit at the Mboumba/Mboga flare site; any re-launch of the GOC flare-to-LNG pilot in newer GOC/AEW statements. If it firms up with an identified operator + concrete step, promote to a new_terminal (likely export/small-scale).
